items.title: 'Detestable, inexcusable, vile': AMC CEO slams Robinhood for tokenized stock offerings
items.summary: AMC (AMC) CEO Adam Aron slammed Robinhood (HOOD) for providing tokenized AMC stock on its platform without approval. Aron described it as "contemptible, outrageous, disgusting, detestable, inexcusable, vile" in a post on X. Watch the video above to learn more.

items.title: ‘Inexcusable, Vile’: AMC Chief Executive Slams Robinhood Stock Tokens
items.summary: AMC Entertainment chief executive Adam Aron criticized Robinhood Markets' Vlad Tenev on X after the broker launched AMC stock tokens.  AMC is among more than 190 companies and ETFs that are now linked to tokens registered by a Robinhood subsidiary on an island roughly 3,000 miles from the U.S.  "This quasi-fake market you are creating on the island of Jersey sows distrust amongst the public about financial markets in general," Aron wrote.

items.title: Cramer Says a Wave of 21 Year Olds on Robinhood Is the Only Reason This Market Has Not Cracked
items.summary: Jim Cramer just credited a wave of young Robinhood investors with keeping the entire market afloat, but the numbers inside that same platform tell a more complicated story about whether this retail bid is a floor or a fuse.

items.title: AMC CEO Slams Robinhood Over 'Inexcusable, Vile' Stock Token Trading
items.summary: AMC CEO takes aim at Robinhood over stock token listings, calls for the broker to remove the offerings. AMC stock jumps.

items.title: Robinhood and AMC Clash Over Tokenized Stock Listing
items.summary: Robinhood refuses AMC’s demand to remove its tokenized stock, escalating a dispute over investor ownership, regulation, and synthetic shares.

items.title: AMC CEO Blasts Robinhood Stock Tokens as AMC Shares Rally
items.summary: AMC’s fight with Robinhood Stock Tokens sent CINEMA soaring, alongside the actual AMC stock, showing how tokenized stocks can be guerrilla marketing machines for public companies.

items.title: 'Send Your Lawyers': Robinhood Isn't Backing Down From AMC Over Stock Tokens
items.summary: Lawyers question AMC’s grounds for a securities-law challenge, but say the tokens’ branding and marketing could leave room for a dispute.
